title: SimpleQA Verified: A Reliable Factuality Benchmark to Measure Parametric Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of question topics (e.g., over-indexing on science and technology) and answer types (e.g., overrepresentation of dates and names) in the benchmark dataset, and mitigating it through adversarial sub-sampling to ensure a balanced evaluation.

Evaluating the diversity of source documents and reference URLs used to generate benchmark questions, and filtering the dataset to ensure no two questions share the same reference URL to prevent over-sampling of specific niche domains preferred by individual human raters.
